name: tests/istanbul/eip152_blake2/test_blake2.py::test_blake2b[fork_London-blockchain_test_from_state_test-invalid-rounds-length-short-call_opcode_CALL]
stateRoot_not_declared: The block header's stateRoot includes the 2 ETH London block reward, but TEST_INTERFACE.md fixes --state.reward=-1 for every graded case, so the tool is asked not to do reward accounting and its post state is 2 ETH short of the header's by construction. txRoot, receiptsRoot, logsBloom, gasUsed and rejected are all computed before the reward is applied and are therefore unaffected; those are what this case declares. expect.stateRoot is kept for provenance and is deliberately absent from expect.checks.
